item.title: Procurement Teams: Extracting Supply Documents Into Usable Records
item.description:
Procurement teams turn supply documents into usable records by capturing key fields (supplier, dates, quantities, unit prices, totals, line items) and matching them against purchase orders before ERP entry. AI extraction with source traceability and human review speeds this up without sacrificing accuracy.

Why Supplier Paperwork Stalls Procurement Work

Supplier documents arrive in every format a vendor can produce. A single category of spend can generate PDFs, scanned faxes, emailed spreadsheets, and photographed packing slips, each with different layouts.

item.title: Click the Number, See the Source: How Traceability Works in Document Extraction
item.description:
Traceability in document extraction links every value an AI pulls from an invoice or receipt to its exact page and position on the original file. Reviewers click a total, date, or line item and see the highlighted source. Verification takes seconds, not a manual re-read of the full document.

Why Extracted Numbers Need a Paper Trail

An extracted number is only as useful as your ability to confirm it. When a total of $4,812.50 flows into your accounting system without a visible origin, your team has two options: trust the tool or re-check the document by hand.

item.title: How to Cut Invoice Processing Time by 70% Without Hiring
item.description:
Accounts payable teams cut invoice processing cycle times by up to 70% by replacing manual data entry with automated optical and neural document extraction. Eliminating keystroke entry, automated line-item capture, and programmatic two- or three-way matching drops cycle times from days to minutes without adding administrative headcount.

Where Accounts Payable Teams Lose Hours

Manual invoice processing forces skilled finance personnel into repetitive administrative mechanics. Standard industry benchmarks from Ardent Partners AP Metrics show that processing an invoice manually takes an average of 8 to 12 days from receipt to payment approval.
